title: Solutions, Colloids and Suspensions
summary: Grade 9: telling solutions, colloids and suspensions apart, the Tyndall effect, concentration by mass and volume, and solubility curves.

ib.statementOfInquiry: The size of the particles in a mixture decides how it behaves, and measuring concentration precisely lets us make safe medicines, foods and cleaners.

factual: How is the concentration of a solution calculated?
conceptual: Why do suspensions settle but colloids don't?
How does temperature affect how much solid dissolves?
debatable: Should packaged drinks have to show their sugar concentration in large print?
